caption: The drawing features a single object, a saber, depicted horizontally with the blade pointing to the right and the hilt to the left. The saber has a gently curved, narrow blade colored in shades of gray with hints of blue and brown, suggesting a metallic appearance. The hilt is rendered in brown and gold tones, featuring a hand guard that extends in a rounded arc. Below the saber, text is inscribed in uppercase letters, reading: '"COL. JAMES A. MULLIGAN SABER" ON THE HILT IS ENGRAVED - LEXINGTON, MO. 1861. WINCHESTER VA., 1864 "LAY ME DOWN AND SAVE THE FLAG"'. The background is plain and off-white, providing contrast to the colored drawing and black text. The composition centers the saber horizontally with the text aligned beneath it.
title: Saber
